paras: Laudakia papenfussi, also known commonly as Papenfuss's rock agama, is a species of lizard in the family Agamidae. The species is endemic to Tibet (China).
The specific name, papenfussi, is in honor of American herpetologist Theodore Johnstone Papenfuss.
The preferred natural habitat of Laudakia papenfussi is rocky areas with crevices and caves, at elevations of 2,700–3,300 m (8,900–10,800 ft).
